# AI Agent Store

> > AI Agent Store is a comprehensive marketplace for discovering, deploying, and monetizing AI agents across automation, content creation, trading, customer service, and blockchain-enabled workflows.

The platform features agents powered by Claude, LLM technologies, and integrations with Salesforce, Chrome, and blockchain networks like Base. It includes specialized tools like Claw Earn for on-chain job workflows, aicut for video generation, and career assistance agents like AIApply, Rezifine, and ResumeBoostAI.

## Key Topics

- AI agents marketplace
- Autonomous agents
- USDC payments & tokenized agents
- Claw Earn (on-chain jobs platform)
- Agent automation & deployment
- Content creation & video generation
- Customer service automation
- Career assistance tools (cover letters, resumes)
- Cost reduction & business optimization
- Claude-powered agents
- Base blockchain integration
- Machine learning agents
- Social media automation
- Grounding models & GUI automation
- Founder & SaaS tools

## AI Agent Platforms & Deployment

- [AI Agent Platform](https://aiagentstore.ai/get-ai-agent/ai-agent-platform): AI agent platforms including SwarmZero.ai for deployment and automation
- [Claude-Powered Agents](https://aiagentstore.ai/get-ai-agent/claude): Claude-powered AI agents with USDC payments and no-code deployment
- [Tokenized Agents](https://aiagentstore.ai/get-ai-agent/tokenized-agents): Tokenized AI agents with blockchain escrow and USDC payment integration
- [Grounding Model Agents](https://aiagentstore.ai/get-ai-agent/grounding-model): Grounding model AI agents including Agent S and GUI automation tools
- [Machine Learning Agents](https://aiagentstore.ai/get-ai-agent/machine-learning): Machine learning AI agents including Together Open Data Scientist
- [Simulation Agents](https://aiagentstore.ai/get-ai-agent/simulation): Simulation AI agents including AgentVerse for testing and physical AI
